description.p: A question that cannot be answered in the terms it was asked.
A sense of lack with no object, or a search whose object cannot yet be named.
Early evidence that something is there: a book, a teacher, a remark that rings true.
A sudden clarity that is real and carries no guarantee that it will last.
A struggle to hold on to something seen, against habits that return quickly.
Disciplined, steady, unglamorous work; progress through regularity.
Ease after effort, with practice and life in agreement.

card.title: The Ox Forgotten, Leaving the Man Alone

description.p: The tool has done its work and can be put down.

card.title: The Ox and the Man Both Gone Out of Sight

description.p: A clearing in which roles, goals and the self that held them lose their grip.
Seeing the situation as it is, without commentary.

card.title: Entering the Market with Open Hands

description.p: Returning to ordinary life and being useful there without announcing it.
A recognition that passes between two people without explanation.
A refusal to explain; solitude in the service of a long task.
A worry looked at directly, which loses its solid form.
Dropping a project of self-improvement whose problem does not exist.
Attention to what is already in front of you.
A loophole used once too often: no insight exempts one from consequences.
A direct interruption that cuts off a borrowed story.
